title: VillagerGirls
description: Replaces villagers, zombie villagers and wandering traders with feminine models.
body:
A cute female redesign for Villagers, Zombie Villagers and Wandering Traders!
![Texture of the different biomes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f20c1f06b8fef2ad286a4a0313d3622c944fa46.gif)

Transform your villages with beautifully redesigned female companions featuring custom 3D models, detailed textures and gothic-inspired voice acting. Each mob includes full support for professions, biome variants and trading levels, all designed to fit naturally within Minecraft's vanilla style while adding a fresh and elegant dark twist.

This resource pack requires support for Custom Entity Models (CEM). You can use a compatible version of OptiFine, or install the Entity Texture Features (ETF) and Entity Model Features (EMF) mods to ensure the custom models and textures work correctly.
